description: Search tee times for up to 50 selected courses on one date. Reuse valid cache and automatically pull missing or expired inventory in bounded batches. Read coverage and deferredCourseIds: unknown or deferred coverage is not proof of no availability. When continuation is present, wait until notBefore, call its tool with its exact arguments, and merge results by course while retaining earlier successful options. Never restart an identical search to bypass continuation cooldowns. If continuation is absent but coverage remains deferred, present it as unknown and invite the golfer to search later.

date.description: Local date in YYYY-MM-DD format, within the next 31 days

refresh.description: Compatibility option; missing or expired inventory is pulled automatically regardless of this value. Valid cache and provider cooldowns are always respected.

retryStalls.description: Internal continuation counter. Copy only from continuation.arguments; do not set it for a new search.

name: search_tee_times
